The uniformly absolutely convergent |sin| Fourier expansion and complex character sums give (A-EA)/n=-(8/pi) sum_m (|S_{m,n}|²/n-1)/(4m²-1). Distinct frequencies are uncorrelated at finite n, yielding uniform L² Fourier-tail control; bounded vector CLT gives iid Exp(1) limits. Euler sine product yields E exp(-sT)=sqrt(1-8s/pi)/sin(pi sqrt(1-8s/pi)/2) for T=4/pi-L. Positive weighted exponentials give ess sup L=4/pi; leading Exp(1) with remainder exponential moment yields exact tail (16/(3pi))exp(-3pi*x/8). Independently checked Fourier area reconstruction for n=3,10,40 with 3000 terms, but proof carries all n/m and sharp tail. Scope fixed half-length unit iid uniform directions in plane.
